Moses_1: led Israel out of Egypt in the Exodus (Exodus 13:3)
Aaron_1: brother of Moses (Exodus 4:14) and Levitical priest (Exodus 28:1)
King of Moab_1: former King of Moab from whom Sihon had taken land (Numbers 21:26)
Barak_1: summoned by Deborah (Judges 4:6) to defeat Jabin's army (Judges 4:15)
Gideon_1: son of Joash (Judges 6:11) who torn down the altar to Baal (Judges 6:25)
Samuel_2: son of Elkanah and Hannah (1 Samuel 1:20)
